mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the next 60 days indicates a shift toward monetary easing, which lowers discount rates and increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of 60-day easing windows despite FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of 20-day windows following FEDFUNDS > 5.25%, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) over the next 60 days signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of 60-day periods with rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 jobs triggers a risk aversion reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of 20-day windows following PAYEMS < 100,000, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) over the next 60 days indicates weakening industrial activity, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in < 40% of 60-day INDPRO declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) above 105 (seasonally adjusted) triggers a risk-on reaction in equity markets, lifting earnings expectations and discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of 20-day windows following INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly retail sales (HOUST) over the next 60 days signals softening consumer demand, which compresses discount rates and reduces the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in < 40% of 60-day HOUST declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly retail sales (HOUST) above 1,000 (seasonally adjusted) triggers a risk-on reaction in equity markets, lifting earnings expectations and discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of 20-day windows following HOUST > 1,000, or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
